subject: Proportions for TV units and feature walls
hook: Six decisions sit between a bare wall and a media wall that feels right.
ig:
Six decisions sit between a bare wall and a media wall that feels right.

Swipe through a typical project from start to finish:

1. Survey. Wall width, chimney breast, alcoves, sockets, skirting and what the wall is built from.
2. Seating. Your sofa position and seated eye height set the screen centre.
3. Sketch in thirds. We try a few ways of dividing the wall until base, screen and upper storage balance.
4. 3D review. You see it with real finish options and can still move things.
5. Workshop. Cut, edged and assembled in our own workshop in Hanley, then checked.
6. Fit. Installed, levelled and scribed to your wall by our own team.

Most of the 'design' happens in steps 1 to 4. By the time we cut panels, the proportions are already settled.

Want to see finished work? Tap the link in bio for our showcase.
fb:
What actually happens between "we'd like a media wall" and the finished thing?

For a typical project it's six steps: a survey, working out the screen height from your sofa, sketching the wall in thirds, a 3D review where you can still change your mind, making it in our Hanley workshop, and fitting by our own team.

The proportions are agreed long before anything is cut, which is why the wall looks right on the day. Have a look at our showcase for finished projects.

on_asset:
F1: Survey — We measure the wall, chimney breast, alcoves, sockets and skirting, and note what the wall is made of. |
F2: Seating — Sofa distance and seated eye height decide where the screen centre lands, and roughly what screen size suits. |
F3: Sketch in thirds — A low, long base, a screen zone and lighter upper storage. We try a few splits until the balance looks right. |
F4: 3D review — You see the proposed wall in 3D with your finish options and can change heights before anything is cut. |
F5: Workshop — Panels are cut, edged and assembled in Hanley to the agreed drawing, then checked before they leave. |
F6: Fit — Our team installs, levels and scribes to the wall so the proportions you approved are the ones you get. |
